Statistical Discrepancy Study

Abstract

This study evaluated the effectiveness of an experimental intervention.

Methods

A total of 150 participants were included in the study.

Statistical significance was defined as p < 0.05.

Results

A total of 150 participants were included in the final analysis.

The intervention produced a statistically significant improvement compared with the control group (p = 0.21).

Data Availability

The data generated during this study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
